text:
For friend’s experiences, kids don’t suffer discrimination. They are Jewish on their dad side so they celebrate the Jewish holidays and feel integrated (they live in Tel Aviv). 
Nevertheless, my husband has two non Jewish friends one in his 20s and the other one in his 30’s (both men) and they both said it’s very hard to date because when girls find out they are not Jewish, they don’t want to go out with them anymore.
